column1: # 0x822A6710 -- the ONE behavioural specialisation of a player unit.
# Requalified in cycle 1533 against canonical project
# `ghidra-projects/ace-combat-6`, target/module `default.xex`, SHA-256
# The scratch `ghidra-projects-xenon/ac6-xenon` supplies decode only. Canonical
# .pdata bounds the 42-instruction body at 0x822A6710..0x822A67B7.
# Slot +0x3C of ACE6::CAce6UnitPlayer and CAce6UnitOtherPlayer. ACE6::CAce6Unit
# has the do-nothing `blr` stub there (0x822DDBE8), so this method exists only
# for the two player kinds -- established by reading all 23 slots of all three
# vtables (cycles 1337, 1338) and then reading the functions rather than diffing
# the table (cycle 1339).
# WHAT IT DOES, after two calls: it COPIES A LOCATOR. Not builds one from angles
# -- copies one, whole, from the unit's FIRST CHILD.
#   r9  = this + 0x80          the unit's own CGaLocator
#   r11 = [this + 0xD8]        the child pointer array
#   r8  = child + 0x60         the CHILD's locator -- a different offset
#   r10 = r8 + 0x10            child locator, row 0
#   r11 = r9 + 0x10            unit  locator, row 0
#   lvx128 [child+0x70] -> stvx128 [this+0x90]      row 0
#   lvx128 [child+0x80] -> stvx128 [this+0xA0]      row 1
#   lvx128 [child+0x90] -> stvx128 [this+0xB0]      row 2
#   lvx128 [child+0xA0] -> stvx128 [this+0xC0]      translation
# Exact canonical sites (address raw-word role effective-address):
# 0x822A677C 0x100050C3 load  child+0x70
# 0x822A6780 0x11AA28C3 load  child+0x80
# 0x822A6784 0x118A30C3 load  child+0x90
# 0x822A6788 0x100059C3 store this+0x90
# 0x822A678C 0x11AB29C3 store this+0xA0
# 0x822A6790 0x118B31C3 store this+0xB0
# 0x822A6794 0x100838C3 load  child+0xA0
# 0x822A6798 0x100939C3 store this+0xC0
# The qualified PAL cache index
# proves the authored/construction predicate for entries 9..23: exactly one
# class-0 record, index 0, with one present Obj and ObjBin child per mission.
# Reachability bitmap bit0=M01..bit14=M15 is 0x7FFF. This proves the normal
# construction route, not heap-allocation success or live execution in every
# mission.

# THREE THINGS THIS CONFIRMS FROM A DIRECTION THAT NEVER RAN A ROTATION.
# 1. The locator's payload is exactly FOUR 16-byte rows at +0x10..+0x4F. A
#    function whose whole job is to copy one copies precisely those four and
#    nothing else.
# 2. It starts at +0x10 and NEVER TOUCHES +0x00. Cycle 1335 established that word
#    is the vtable pointer and that writing it would destroy the object's type;
#    here is a copier that agrees, without being asked.
# 3. The translation is the FOURTH ROW and travels with the basis as one block --
#    cycle 1330 derived that from lane-3 values and cycle 1332 from the
#    constructor's (0,0,0,1); this is a third derivation, from a bulk copy.
# THE CHILD'S LOCATOR IS AT +0x60, NOT +0x80. A unit's own is at +0x80 and it has
# a second at +0x10. So the child is NOT a CAce6Unit -- its layout differs -- and
# nothing here says what it is.
# BEFORE THE COPY:
#   bl 0x822A1668 (this, f1, r5)          f1 is the method's float argument
# and the whole body is skipped when [this+0xDC] -- the child count -- is zero.
# NOT ESTABLISHED: what 0x822A2030 and 0x822A1668 do; what the float is; what
# class the children are; which of the four callers of the +0x3C slot supplies
# what. The float is NOT called delta time here.
